segments.text: We've already examined chromatography as an efficient process for separating components
segments.zh: 我们已经了解过色谱法，它是一种根据极性不同来分离混合物各组分的

segments.text: of a mixture on the basis of differing polarity.
segments.zh: 高效方法。

segments.text: This occurs due to different degrees of interaction with the stationary phase, as components are
segments.zh: 这是由于各组分与固定相的相互作用程度不同，因为各组分

segments.text: pushed along with a mobile phase.
segments.zh: 是随流动相一起被推动前进的。

segments.text: But for TLC, we are only able to separate the tiny bit of the mixture that is spotted
segments.zh: 但对于 TLC，我们只能分离点在板上的

segments.text: onto the plate.
segments.zh: 那一点点混合物。

segments.text: We will often want to perform chromatography on large samples.
segments.zh: 我们常常需要对大量样品进行色谱分离。

segments.text: For this we will need column chromatography, a commonly used technique in chemistry, biology,
segments.zh: 为此我们需要柱色谱，这是化学、生物学

segments.text: and industry, which we have covered from a conceptual standpoint over in the lecture-based
segments.zh: 和工业中常用的一种技术，我们已经在讲授型系列中

segments.text: series, so be sure to review that video for additional context.
segments.zh: 从概念层面讲过它，所以一定要回顾那期视频，了解更多背景。

segments.text: To perform column chromatography, we will need a column, that's this.
segments.zh: 要进行柱色谱，我们需要一根色谱柱，就是这个。

segments.text: This will be loaded with the stationary phase.
segments.zh: 柱子里要装填固定相。

segments.text: The mobile phase is a solvent solution that moves down through the column along with
segments.zh: 流动相是一种溶剂溶液，它会和样品一起沿着色谱柱

segments.text: your sample, just as solvent moved up the plate in TLC.
segments.zh: 向下移动，就像 TLC 中溶剂沿着板向上移动一样。

segments.text: You can then collect fractions as they come out of the column, using a series of small
segments.zh: 然后你可以用一系列小烧瓶，在各馏分流出色谱柱时

segments.text: flasks, such that the components of the mixture will arrive in different fractions
segments.zh: 收集它们，这样混合物的各组分就会出现在不同的馏分中，

segments.text: due to their differing rates of travel down the column, according to how well they interact
segments.zh: 因为它们沿色谱柱向下移动的速度不同，这取决于它们与

segments.text: with the stationary phase.
segments.zh: 固定相相互作用的强弱。

segments.text: The most common type of column chromatography in a chemistry lab is silica gel column chromatography.
segments.zh: 化学实验室中最常见的柱色谱类型是硅胶柱色谱。

segments.text: Solvent is added to the gel to form a slurry, and this slurry of silica gel acts as the
segments.zh: 向硅胶中加入溶剂形成匀浆，这种硅胶匀浆充当

segments.text: stationary phase, while the solvent system that passes through the column acts as the
segments.zh: 固定相，而流过色谱柱的溶剂体系充当

segments.text: mobile phase.
segments.zh: 流动相。

segments.text: The stationary phase can separate compounds based on their differences in polarity precisely
segments.zh: 固定相可以根据化合物极性的差异来分离它们，原理与

segments.text: the same way as the TLC plate, only now moving through a 3D matrix rather than along
segments.zh: TLC 板完全相同，只不过现在是穿过三维基质，而不是沿着

segments.text: a 2D surface.
segments.zh: 二维表面移动。

segments.text: The key concept is still adsorption.
segments.zh: 关键概念仍然是吸附。

segments.text: The materials being separated are attracted to the silica beads to differing degrees depending
segments.zh: 被分离的物质会根据各自的极性，不同程度地被硅胶颗粒吸引，

segments.text: on their polarity, because of all the hydroxyl groups protruding from their surfaces, which
segments.zh: 因为硅胶表面伸出许多羟基，这些羟基

segments.text: can make hydrogen bonds or other types of dipole-dipole interactions with polar molecules,
segments.zh: 可以与极性分子形成氢键或其他类型的偶极-偶极相互作用，

segments.text: which will cause them to move more slowly through the column.
segments.zh: 这会使极性分子在色谱柱中移动得更慢。

segments.text: Less polar molecules will move more quickly since they won't interact as well with
segments.zh: 极性较小的分子会移动得更快，因为它们与固定相的相互作用

segments.text: the stationary phase and are thus pushed along with the solvent.
segments.zh: 没那么强，因此会随溶剂一起被推着走。

segments.text: Now it's time to perform the technique.
segments.zh: 现在开始实际操作这项技术。

segments.text: We'll start by packing our glass column.
segments.zh: 我们先来装填玻璃色谱柱。

segments.text: As you can see, the column has a stopcock at the bottom, so make sure it's closed.
segments.zh: 如你所见，色谱柱底部有一个活塞，所以要确保它是关着的。

segments.text: We'll then add a cotton ball to the bottom.
segments.zh: 然后我们在底部塞一个棉球。

segments.text: This is so that our gel doesn't go through, as it is a fine powder and can easily slip
segments.zh: 这是为了不让硅胶漏下去，因为硅胶是细粉，打开活塞时

segments.text: through when we open the stopcock.
segments.zh: 很容易漏出来。

segments.text: Using a glass rod like this one, we'll push the cotton down like this.
segments.zh: 用一根像这样的玻璃棒，我们像这样把棉花往下压。

segments.text: Let's then secure our column to a ring stand and clamps.
segments.zh: 然后我们用铁架台和夹子把色谱柱固定好。

segments.text: Next we will add a fine layer of sand so that it fills the curved bottom section and forms
segments.zh: 接下来我们加一薄层沙子，让它填满弯曲的底部，并在

segments.text: a level surface on top of the cotton ball.
segments.zh: 棉球上方形成一个平整的表面。

segments.text: Add some solvent to clean the sand off the sides by using a pasture pipette.
segments.zh: 用巴斯德滴管加一些溶剂，把柱壁上的沙子冲下来。

segments.text: We want all the sand to go to the bottom and not mix with our silica.
segments.zh: 我们希望所有沙子都到底部，而不会和硅胶混在一起。

segments.text: Make sure the sand level is as horizontal as possible.
segments.zh: 确保沙层尽可能水平。

segments.text: If it's a little slanted, you can just gently tap the side of the column like this.
segments.zh: 如果有点倾斜，你可以像这样轻轻敲一敲柱子侧面。

segments.text: Now we're going to prepare the gel by adding 25 milliliters of our solvent to the silica
segments.zh: 现在我们来制备硅胶匀浆，往硅胶粉中加入 25 毫升

segments.text: powder.
segments.zh: 溶剂。

segments.text: The solvent we're using is also known as the eluent for column chromatography.
segments.zh: 我们使用的溶剂在柱色谱中也叫洗脱剂。

segments.text: An appropriate solvent for column chromatography can be chosen by performing TLC on your mixture
segments.zh: 合适的柱色谱溶剂可以这样选择：用各种溶剂和溶剂组合，比如正己烷和乙酸乙酯，

segments.text: in various solvents and combinations, such as hexanes and ethyl acetate.
segments.zh: 对你的混合物进行 TLC。

segments.text: You can then choose one that gives the best separation.
segments.zh: 然后你就可以选出分离效果最好的那一种。

segments.text: Since the TLC plate also utilizes silica, just like in our column, the separation pattern
segments.zh: 由于 TLC 板和我们的色谱柱一样，也使用硅胶，

segments.text: will therefore be the same.
segments.zh: 所以分离模式是相同的。

segments.text: In today's experiment we're using a 1 to 1 acetone ethanol mixture as our solvent.
segments.zh: 在今天的实验中，我们用 1:1 的丙酮-乙醇混合物作为溶剂。

segments.text: Let's add it to the silica powder.
segments.zh: 我们把它加入硅胶粉中。

segments.text: The size of your column and volume of your mixture will determine how much silica and
segments.zh: 色谱柱的大小和混合物的体积决定了你要用多少硅胶和

segments.text: solvent you use.
segments.zh: 溶剂。

segments.text: You need a level tall enough to allow complete separation of your samples, and you should
segments.zh: 你需要足够高的柱床，以便样品能完全分离，你应该

segments.text: aim for this filling up about two thirds of the column.
segments.zh: 争取让它填满色谱柱的大约三分之二。

segments.text: Let's stir the mixture with our rod until we get a nice slurry.
segments.zh: 我们用玻璃棒搅拌混合物，直到得到均匀的匀浆。

segments.text: After we've made a slurry of our silica, we'll add it to our column by using a glass
segments.zh: 制好硅胶匀浆后，我们用玻璃漏斗把它

segments.text: funnel.
segments.zh: 加入色谱柱中。

segments.text: You want to keep mixing with a stir rod right up until you pour it in quickly like this.
segments.zh: 你要一直用玻璃棒搅拌，直到像这样迅速倒进去为止。

segments.text: Use more solvent to remove the rest of the silica from the beaker, and also to wash
segments.zh: 再用一些溶剂把烧杯中剩余的硅胶冲下来，同时冲洗

segments.text: any gel off the sides of the column.
segments.zh: 粘在柱壁上的硅胶。

segments.text: For reference, this is called wet loading.
segments.zh: 顺便说一下，这叫做湿法装柱。

segments.text: An alternative is dry loading, which consists of adding the dry powder to the column, and
segments.zh: 另一种方法是干法装柱，就是先把干粉加入色谱柱，

segments.text: then the solvent after.
segments.zh: 然后再加溶剂。

segments.text: This technique can cause a lot of bubbles that interfere with the separation, and tends
segments.zh: 这种方法可能会产生大量气泡，干扰分离，而且往往

segments.text: to be less effective, so wet loading is suggested.
segments.zh: 效果较差，所以建议使用湿法装柱。

segments.text: As you add the gel to your column, be sure to tap on the column gently to make sure
segments.zh: 把硅胶加入色谱柱时，一定要轻轻敲击柱子，确保

segments.text: it stays flat on top, and to get rid of any bubbles or uneven packing.
segments.zh: 顶部保持平整，并消除气泡或填充不均匀的地方。

segments.text: After we've packed our column, we'll open the stopcock to remove some of the
segments.zh: 装好柱后，我们打开活塞，放出一部分

segments.text: solvent.
segments.zh: 溶剂。

segments.text: For chromatography, it is important that you don't let your column run dry, meaning
segments.zh: 做色谱时，很重要的一点是不要让色谱柱干掉，也就是说

segments.text: all of the gel must always be submerged in solvent.
segments.zh: 所有硅胶必须始终浸没在溶剂中。

segments.text: In other words, the solvent line must always remain above the stationary phase.
segments.zh: 换句话说，溶剂液面必须始终高于固定相。

segments.text: As you progress with the technique, you will always keep an eye on the solvent line
segments.zh: 在操作过程中，你要始终留意溶剂液面，

segments.text: and add more solvent when necessary to keep the column wet.
segments.zh: 必要时加入更多溶剂，保持色谱柱湿润。

segments.text: If it is not wet, it can cause cracking of the silica, which will cause unreliable separation.
segments.zh: 如果柱子不湿润，就可能导致硅胶开裂，使分离结果不可靠。

segments.text: For right now, let's allow the solvent line to go down until it's above the
segments.zh: 现在，我们让溶剂液面下降，直到它刚好高于

segments.text: silica gel line like this.
segments.zh: 硅胶层，像这样。

segments.text: We're now ready to load the sample.
segments.zh: 现在我们可以上样了。

segments.text: Today we're separating a mixture of methyl red and bromocresyl green.
segments.zh: 今天我们要分离的是甲基红和溴甲酚绿的混合物。

segments.text: You may know them as indicators that are used in titration, but if you look at their structures,
segments.zh: 你可能知道它们是滴定中使用的指示剂，但如果你看看它们的结构，

segments.text: you can see that they have different functional groups, which allows them to be separated
segments.zh: 就会发现它们有不同的官能团，这使得它们可以

segments.text: based on their polarities.
segments.zh: 根据极性被分离开。

segments.text: You can see that bromocresyl green has many polar groups, and that makes it more
segments.zh: 你可以看到，溴甲酚绿有很多极性基团，这使它的极性

segments.text: polar than methyl red.
segments.zh: 比甲基红大。

segments.text: We are using these chemicals today because they are brightly colored, and we can therefore
segments.zh: 我们今天使用这些化学物质，是因为它们颜色鲜艳，因此我们可以

segments.text: visualize them as they move through the column, which will help us understand what is happening.
segments.zh: 在它们穿过色谱柱时看到它们，这有助于我们理解正在发生什么。

segments.text: This will usually not be the case.
segments.zh: 通常情况并非如此。

segments.text: Typically we can't see compounds as they move through the column, which makes things
segments.zh: 一般来说，化合物在色谱柱中移动时我们是看不见的，这让操作

segments.text: more challenging.
segments.zh: 更具挑战性。

segments.text: When adding your sample to the column, if you have isolated the organic products from
segments.zh: 往色谱柱中加样品时，如果你从化学反应中分离出的有机产物

segments.text: a chemical reaction to form an oil, we want to dissolve that oil in as small an amount
segments.zh: 是一种油状物，我们要把这种油状物溶解在尽可能少的

segments.text: of our solvent as possible.
segments.zh: 溶剂中。

segments.text: This will allow us to load the sample as a thin band, which will result in good separation.
segments.zh: 这样我们就能把样品上成一条窄带，从而得到良好的分离效果。

segments.text: If we use too much solvent, the compounds will be very spread out, and it will be harder
segments.zh: 如果我们用太多溶剂，化合物就会非常分散，也就更难

segments.text: to separate them.
segments.zh: 把它们分开。

segments.text: Today, our mixture is already ready to load.
segments.zh: 今天，我们的混合物已经可以直接上样了。

segments.text: To load the sample, we have to be careful.
segments.zh: 上样时必须小心。

segments.text: We usually take it into a glass pipette, and then lower the pipette as close to the
segments.zh: 我们通常把样品吸进玻璃滴管里，然后把滴管尽量下伸到

segments.text: top of the column as possible, slowly letting it out to make sure that our layer is even.
segments.zh: 靠近柱床顶部的位置，慢慢放出样品，确保样品层均匀。

segments.text: We have to be gentle because we don't want to disturb the silica layer.
segments.zh: 我们必须轻柔，因为我们不想扰动硅胶层。

segments.text: In this case, we're adding a quarter of a milliliter of a mixture of our two samples,
segments.zh: 在这里，我们加入四分之一毫升这两种样品的混合物，

segments.text: and we can allow it to run down part of the side of the column to load gently.
segments.zh: 可以让它沿着柱壁的一部分流下去，以便轻柔上样。

segments.text: After loading the sample and verifying that all of it has been adsorbed onto the column,
segments.zh: 上好样并确认样品已全部吸附到柱上之后，

segments.text: we can add another layer of sand as a protective layer.
segments.zh: 我们可以再加一层沙子作为保护层。

segments.text: Let's add about a centimeter.
segments.zh: 我们加大约一厘米。

segments.text: We can now fill up the column with our eluent.
segments.zh: 现在可以用洗脱剂把色谱柱加满了。

segments.text: We're now ready to run our column and collect the fractions.
segments.zh: 现在我们可以开始过柱并收集馏分了。

segments.text: Let's open the stopcock.
segments.zh: 我们打开活塞。

segments.text: We don't have to start collecting fractions immediately, as there is no way for our compounds
segments.zh: 我们不必立即开始收集馏分，因为化合物不可能

segments.text: to immediately be exiting the column, but soon after beginning you will want to begin
segments.zh: 马上就流出色谱柱，但开始后不久，你就要开始

segments.text: collecting fractions in numbered vessels.
segments.zh: 用编好号的容器收集馏分了。

segments.text: Typically these will be small Erlenmeyer flasks, but today we will be using test tubes.
segments.zh: 通常这些容器是小锥形瓶，但今天我们要用试管。

segments.text: Start collecting and just move to the next one whenever the current one is full, or sooner
segments.zh: 开始收集，每当当前这个装满时，就换下一个，或者如果

segments.text: if you think that a new substance is about to exit the column.
segments.zh: 你认为有新的物质即将流出色谱柱，就提前更换。

segments.text: It is very important that you monitor the solvent level as you collect your samples.
segments.zh: 收集样品时，监控溶剂液面是非常重要的。

segments.text: When you open the stopcock, the solvent level will start to go down.
segments.zh: 打开活塞后，溶剂液面会开始下降。

segments.text: Remember that we can't let our column dry, so we have to add more solvent as the level
segments.zh: 记住我们不能让色谱柱干掉，所以液面下降时

segments.text: goes down.
segments.zh: 必须补加溶剂。

segments.text: We also want to be careful when adding more solvent, as we do not want to disturb the
segments.zh: 补加溶剂时也要小心，因为我们不想扰动

segments.text: column.
segments.zh: 柱床。

segments.text: Add more before the level gets all the way down to the gel, and add carefully, letting
segments.zh: 在液面降到硅胶之前就要补加，而且要小心地加，让它

segments.text: it run down the sides.
segments.zh: 沿着柱壁流下去。

segments.text: Continuing, we can see that our mixture is starting to separate into individual components.
segments.zh: 继续下去，我们可以看到混合物开始分离成单独的组分。

segments.text: Again, since we have colored chemicals, it will be easier to observe the separation.
segments.zh: 同样，由于我们用的是有颜色的化学物质，分离会更容易观察。

segments.text: The dark green mixture we started with is separating into blue and yellow colors.
segments.zh: 我们一开始的深绿色混合物正在分成蓝色和黄色。

segments.text: This is why we have to collect fractions.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么我们必须分段收集馏分。

segments.text: If we just collect these in one container, they will mix together again.
segments.zh: 如果我们把它们都收集在一个容器里，它们又会重新混在一起。

segments.text: This way we isolate the components in separate fractions.
segments.zh: 这样我们就把各组分分离到了不同的馏分中。

segments.text: At first you will be collecting only solvent, but as you can see, the yellow band is getting
segments.zh: 一开始你收集到的只有溶剂，但如你所见，黄色色带越来越

segments.text: closer to the bottom.
segments.zh: 接近底部了。

segments.text: Keep adding the eluent and collecting fractions until you have collected all your compounds.
segments.zh: 继续加洗脱剂并收集馏分，直到收集到所有化合物为止。

segments.text: When the compounds are not visible, you will have to perform TLC to find out what's
segments.zh: 当化合物看不见时，你就必须做 TLC，来确定

segments.text: in each fraction.
segments.zh: 每个馏分里有什么。

segments.text: You can test many fractions on one plate, and all the fractions that show data for
segments.zh: 你可以在一块板上检测许多馏分，所有显示含有

segments.text: a particular compound can be combined and the solvent evaporated, to give you a pure
segments.zh: 某一化合物的馏分都可以合并，再蒸发掉溶剂，就能得到纯净的

segments.text: isolated product.
segments.zh: 分离产物。

segments.text: If you know for sure which compound you want, you can dispose of the rest, but sometimes
segments.zh: 如果你确定自己想要哪种化合物，就可以把其余的处理掉，但有时

segments.text: you will want to isolate two or more products.
segments.zh: 你会想要分离出两种或更多产物。

segments.text: There are times where, rather than TLC, you will want to analyze the fractions by absorbance
segments.zh: 有时候，你会不用 TLC，而是用吸收

segments.text: spectroscopy, UV, or a colorimetric assay to figure out the identities of any compounds.
segments.zh: 光谱、紫外或比色法来分析馏分，以确定各化合物的身份。

segments.text: But in this particular case we were able to isolate these compounds using just our eyes.
segments.zh: 但在这个例子中，我们只用肉眼就能分离出这些化合物。

segments.text: Column chromatography can get much more complex than this.
segments.zh: 柱色谱可以比这复杂得多。

segments.text: In several forms of chromatography, we use more than one solvent system, either in succession
segments.zh: 在好几种色谱方法中，我们会使用不止一种溶剂体系，要么依次使用，

segments.text: or applied as a gradient, usually increasing in polarity over time to push out substances
segments.zh: 要么以梯度方式施加，通常极性随时间逐渐增大，以便把

segments.text: that traveled more slowly.

segments.text: Furthermore, the material in the column can be agarose, acrylamide, or some other compound
segments.zh: 此外，色谱柱中的材料可以是琼脂糖、丙烯酰胺或其他化合物，

segments.text: depending on what we're separating.

segments.text: In the lab we can use columns to separate things such as peptides or drugs based on
segments.zh: 在实验室里，我们可以用色谱柱根据大小、电荷、极性或其他亲和性等方面

segments.text: The packing, mixing, and collection of these can also be automated in large-scale academic
segments.zh: 在大规模的学术和工业流程中，这些柱子的装填、混合和收集也可以

segments.text: and industrial processes.

segments.text: A sophisticated example of column chromatography is FPLC, or fast protein liquid chromatography,
segments.zh: 柱色谱的一个复杂例子是 FPLC，即快速蛋白液相色谱，

segments.text: a technique that is used to separate proteins.
segments.zh: 这是一种用于分离蛋白质的技术。

segments.text: But for now, that concludes an introduction to column chromatography.
